meaning: Same-seed recording replay of published 2000 truncated_reset trajectories, not new independent samples/fits or new confirmation
acceptance: Every existing CSV sample vector and first-hit time matches exactly. Retain all newly recorded complete states, residual refractory time, every event hit/side/refractory/release time, PCG64 boundary states, all failures, and costs
publication: Publish new helper/protocol before replay; unchanged archived source/CSV hashes before and after. No older source or validation code modified
limits: Full event histories not preserved in original CSV are now exposed by deterministic same-seed replay. They are not additional independent scientific observations
